I am working with our ServiceNow portal. My boss asks me to onboard a new user. After creating the new user profile, I navigate to order an Apple Mac Book Pro for this user and complete the order. What step remains? (Select ONE.)

B. Navigate back to the onboarding task -> write a brief summary in Additional comments for the hiring manager/requester -> click Close Task (or set state to Closed - Complete).
C. Verify the Request Item (RITM) was successfully created -> link it to the parent onboarding ticket -> then mark the onboarding task as Complete/Closed - Complete to trigger the next workflow phase.
D. Create a new hardware record -> then return to the onboarding task page and change the status/state from Open to Closed - Complete.
E. Return to the new user profile (sys_user) -> confirm the MacBook request is associated with the user/asset context -> validate provisioning details (delivery location/approvals) -> then close the onboarding task as Closed - Complete.
F. Open the created MacBook request -> verify it is submitted and assigned to the correct fulfillment group -> notify the requester/manager with the tracking details -> then close the onboarding task as Closed - Complete.
G. Return to the onboarding task -> reassign/hand off the task to the next fulfillment team -> set the task state to In Progress (so they can continue fulfillment).
H. Create a new hardware record -> open the MacBook request and attach the hardware record -> then send the new user a completion message and close the onboarding task as Closed - Complete.
